paragraphs.text: The Omenpath Era is an era in history on Dominaria following the effects of the Desparkening , which removed the sparks from many planeswalkers and opened up Omenpaths through the Multiverse .

Events in the era include the Wicked Slumber on Eldraine , the establishment of towns on Thunder Junction , the crime wave on Ravnica , the discovery of Ixalan's Core , the opening of the vault at Tarnation , the theft of Maha 's egg on Bloomburrow , and the infiltration of the Multiverse by the plane of Duskmourn .
